note: Entry point declared for a0/conformance/conformance.py (its discovery order is adapters.json, then this file, then heuristics). Every path here is relative to this manifest's directory, which is the runner's launch cwd (a0/conformance/conformance.py:3773-3776), so a copy of the tree launches the copy's adapter; an absolute host root would launch the original. The adapter imports the pinned KAPSO checkout from PYTHONPATH (config/adapter.json: kapso_src, overridable with A0_KAPSO_SRC); it never installs into it.
